"Based on our performance through the first nine months of the year, we are reaffirming our full-year guidance.

After adjusting for the impact of the GE Healthcare contract restructuring, we continue to expect pro-forma revenue growth of 6% to 8% for 2026 and Adjusted EBITDA margins in the low-to-mid 20% range.
We also are continuing to forecast Adjusted EBITDA margin (non-GAAP) to be in the low-to-mid 20% range.

This includes the implementation expenses for the Company's upgraded information technology systems which went on-line on March 1, 2026, as well as modest additional investments in workflow automation and software-enabled process improvements within our Patient Services platform, which are expected to begin in the fourth quarter.
The full year 2026 guidance reflects management’s current expectations for operational performance, given the current market conditions.
